blocks.text: You can change the business units for each organization unit (OU), management group, single account, or multiple accounts.

When a business unit is assigned to an OU or a management group, all the accounts within that OU or management group are assigned to the same business unit. For example, if an OU has 5 accounts and BU1 is assigned to the OU, all 5 accounts within that OU are assigned to BU1.
Changing the business unit overrides the currently assigned business unit.
You must be assigned either an Administrator role or any role with the Business Unit Mapping permission.

blocks.heading: Changing a Business Unit for an OU or Management Group

blocks.text: To change a business unit for an OU or management group:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
The Cloud Accounts page appears.
On the Cloud Accounts page, click the required cloud account (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Click Manage, and then select Business Units Mapping from the drop-down menu.
See image.
The Business Units Mapping page appears.
On the Business Units Mapping page, assign a business unit to the OU. All the accounts in the OU are mapped to the selected business unit.
See image.
Click Done.
A message appears indicating that the business unit was changed successfully.

blocks.heading: Changing a Business Unit for Single or Multiple Accounts

blocks.text: To change a business unit for single or multiple accounts:
In this article, changing business unit for an AWS account is shown as an example.

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
The Cloud Accounts page appears.
On the Cloud Accounts page, click the required cloud account.
Select the organization and then select the Accounts tab.
See image.
Choose any of the following options:
To change a business unit for a single account:
Click the Actions icon for the account you want to change the business unit, then select Change Business Unit.
See image.
To change a business unit for multiple accounts:
Select the checkboxes for the required accounts and then select Change Business Unit.
See image.
The Change Business Unit window appears.
In the Change Business Unit window, select the business unit from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Click Apply.
A message appears indicating that the business unit was changed successfully.
